# ChemicalJS browser distribution

These client and Ultraviolet files are copied from the official npm release
https://registry.npmjs.org/chemicaljs/-/chemicaljs-2.6.4.tgz
(npm shasum 8184aa1e8f1a5ed5afe2c817f4bc84ccb4a2d024).

The browser assets are unchanged. The local package manifest omits the original
server dependencies, including deleted GitHub tarballs for Scramjet and
Rammerhead. Orbit uses ChemicalJS's Ultraviolet browser mode only. Its build
generates the configuration preamble normally generated by ChemicalBuild.
See LICENSE for the upstream AGPL-3.0 license. Preserve this directory when
uploading the project; the build depends on it.
